title: 进场考核：二十五道判断题
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/21_Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Saudi Aramco Safety Officer Test HSE STUD.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/21_Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Saudi Aramco Safety Officer Test HSE STUD/src.py

points.K3: 发电机供电也要漏电保护
points.K4: 无车通行的坑可用警示带
points.K9: 饭前洗手要有肥皂纸巾
points.K13: 手持电动工具不能锁定开关
points.K22: 劳保用品不等于绝缘用品
points.S2: 实验楼禁烟与明火管理
points.S3: 不私自改装仪器和电路
points.S4: 大桶溶剂分装用泵和倾倒架

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白判断题卡，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank true-or-false card and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天二十五道判断题，对还是错？
overlay: 进场考核：二十五道判断题

shots.scene: 一行图标：对勾、叉、梯子、插头、火焰
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a check mark, a cross, a ladder, a plug and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子、用电、施工、灭火，样样都有。

shots.scene: 实验楼门口，施工人员排队，王老师发考卷
shots.prompt_en: At a laboratory building entrance, construction workers line up while the safety administrator hands out blank test sheets.
shots.narration: 实验楼要改造，施工人员先考核再进场。

shots.scene: 阿杰也拿到一张，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student also receives a sheet and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰也来凑热闹，一起答。

shots.scene: 考卷上的分值图示
shots.prompt_en: A blank test sheet with small number blocks showing questions and points. No text.
shots.narration: 二十五题，每题两分，八成及格。

shots.scene: 阿杰捂住答案自己先答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student covers the answer key and answers first.
shots.narration: 先自己判断，再对答案。

shots.scene: 双面梯两侧各站一人的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two people standing on both sides of a double-sided stepladder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：双面梯能两人同时上吗？

shots.scene: 一人上梯、一人扶梯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer climbs a stepladder while a worker holds it steady.
shots.narration: 错。一人上，另一人在下面扶。

shots.section_title: 发电机供电也要漏电保护
shots.scene: 现场发电机连着手持电钻
shots.prompt_en: A portable site generator powering a hand drill. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：发电机供电就不用漏电保护？
overlay: 发电机供电也要漏电保护

shots.section_title: 发电机供电也要漏电保护
shots.scene: 线路上装着带试验按钮的漏电保护器
shots.prompt_en: A residual current protection device with a test button installed on the cable. No people.
shots.narration: 错。手持电动工具都要有漏电保护。

shots.section_title: 发电机供电也要漏电保护
shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按国家标准安装，以现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 无车通行的坑可用警示带
shots.scene: 无车经过的浅坑四周拉着红白警示带
shots.prompt_en: A small pit with no vehicle traffic, surrounded by red and white barrier tape. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：没有车经过的坑能用警示带？
overlay: 无车通行的坑可用警示带

shots.section_title: 无车通行的坑可用警示带
shots.scene: 车道旁的坑改用硬质围挡
shots.prompt_en: A pit beside a road protected by solid barriers instead of tape. No people.
shots.narration: 对。有车经过就要用硬质围挡。

shots.scene: 普通大塑料桶装柴油的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plain large plastic drum filled with diesel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：新塑料桶能装柴油吗？

shots.scene: 合格的燃料安全罐，打勾
shots.prompt_en: An approved metal fuel safety can with a label, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 错。要用合格的专用容器。

shots.scene: 工地上指定吸烟点的标识
shots.prompt_en: A designated smoking area sign at a construction site, far from buildings. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：只能在指定点吸烟？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 对。其他地方一律禁烟。

shots.scene: 电钻对着安全帽钻孔的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drill making holes in a safety helmet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：安全帽能钻孔通风吗？

shots.scene: 安全帽受冲击开裂的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drilled helmet cracking under impact. No people.
shots.narration: 错。钻孔会削弱强度，撞击时开裂。

shots.scene: 断扳手焊着一截管子的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a broken wrench with a piece of pipe welded on, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：工具断了焊根管子行吗？

shots.scene: 坏工具放进报废箱，换新工具
shots.prompt_en: A broken tool goes into a scrap box and a new tool is taken from the rack. No people.
shots.narration: 错。坏了就报废，换合格工具。

shots.section_title: 饭前洗手要有肥皂纸巾
shots.scene: 洗手池旁的肥皂和纸巾
shots.prompt_en: A handwashing sink with soap and paper towels. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：饭前要备肥皂纸巾？
overlay: 饭前洗手要有肥皂纸巾

shots.section_title: 饭前洗手要有肥皂纸巾
shots.scene: 老李饭前认真洗手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer washes his hands carefully before lunch.
shots.narration: 对。手上可能沾着有害物质。

shots.scene: 工人穿胶靴浇混凝土
shots.prompt_en: A worker in rubber boots stands beside freshly poured concrete. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：浇混凝土要穿胶靴？

shots.scene: 湿混凝土碰皮肤的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning icon of wet concrete touching skin. No people.
shots.narration: 对。湿混凝土碱性强，会灼伤皮肤。

shots.scene: 钢头胶靴剖面，前端有钢板
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a rubber boot showing a steel toe cap. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：穿了胶靴就不用钢头？

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head.
shots.narration: 错。脚趾照样要防砸。

shots.scene: 甲烷分子图标，旁边火焰和窒息图标
shots.prompt_en: A methane molecule icon with a flame icon and a suffocation icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：甲烷没毒就没危险？

shots.scene: 气体检测仪报警
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector shows an alarm. No people.
shots.narration: 错。无色无味，能燃爆，也能致窒息。

shots.section_title: 手持电动工具不能锁定开关
shots.scene: 角磨机开关被锁定常开的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an angle grinder with its trigger locked on, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：干得久能锁定开关吗？
overlay: 手持电动工具不能锁定开关

shots.section_title: 手持电动工具不能锁定开关
shots.scene: 原题答案卡片旁打问号
shots.prompt_en: An answer card marked true with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原答案说能，这是危险做法。

shots.section_title: 手持电动工具不能锁定开关
shots.scene: 手一松，工具立即停转
shots.prompt_en: A hand releases the trigger and the grinder stops at once. No people.
shots.narration: 要用松手即停，失手时才不乱转。

shots.scene: 脚手架踏板用卡扣固定在横杆上
shots.prompt_en: Scaffold planks clipped and tied to the support bars. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：踏板要固定吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 对。不固定会滑动翻落。

shots.scene: 屋顶上的风向袋被风吹起
shots.prompt_en: A windsock on a rooftop blows in the wind. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四题：风向袋是干什么的？

shots.scene: 泄漏气体顺着风向飘的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow shows leaked gas drifting downwind. No people.
shots.narration: 对。看它就知道泄漏往哪飘。

shots.scene: 王老师一天几次巡查施工现场，时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator inspects the construction site several times; clock icons show different times.
shots.narration: 第十五题：安全员一天要巡查几次？

shots.scene: 现场情况不断变化的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of changing site conditions: new materials, moved barriers, new workers. No people.
shots.narration: 对。现场一直在变，要多次巡查。

shots.scene: 笔记本上记录隐患，旁边日历指向下周
shots.prompt_en: A notebook with a hazard note, and a calendar pointing to next week's meeting. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六题：隐患记下来等例会再说？

shots.scene: 原题答案卡片旁打问号
shots.prompt_en: An answer card marked true with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原答案说对，但重大隐患不能等。

shots.scene: 王老师当场叫停，并打电话报告
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops the work on the spot and phones to report.
shots.narration: 立即报告、立即处理，再记录跟踪。

shots.scene: 塔吊旁的风速计转得飞快
shots.prompt_en: An anemometer spins fast beside a crane. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七题：风大要停止起重吗？

shots.scene: 吊钩放下，起重停止
shots.prompt_en: The crane lowers its load and stops. No people.
shots.narration: 对。限值按标准和设备说明书。

shots.scene: 吊篮载人在风中摇晃的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a crane-suspended personnel basket swinging in strong wind, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第十八题：风大还能吊篮载人？

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head.
shots.narration: 不能，载人作业要求更严。

shots.scene: 导线里电子沿一个方向移动的动画图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a copper wire with small dots moving in one direction. No people.
shots.narration: 第十九题：电流是什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 对，是金属导体里电子的定向移动。

shots.scene: 完好的电缆和插头打勾，破损的打叉
shots.prompt_en: An intact cable and plug with a green check beside a damaged one with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十题：电缆插头要保持完好？

shots.scene: 阿杰发现破损插头，报告老李
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finds a damaged plug and reports it to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 对。发现破损立即停用报告。

shots.section_title: 劳保用品不等于绝缘用品
shots.scene: 普通线手套、劳保鞋和绝缘手套、绝缘靴对比
shots.prompt_en: Ordinary work gloves and boots beside electrical insulating gloves and boots. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十一题：劳保用品能防触电吗？
overlay: 劳保用品不等于绝缘用品

shots.section_title: 劳保用品不等于绝缘用品
shots.scene: 普通手套触碰电线的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ordinary glove touching a live wire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通手套鞋帽，不能当绝缘用品。

shots.scene: 仪器外壳接地线连到大地
shots.prompt_en: An instrument case connected to earth by a green and yellow ground wire. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十二题：接地不重要？

shots.scene: 漏电时电流经接地线流走
shots.prompt_en: Fault current flows away through the ground wire instead of a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 错。漏电时靠它把电流导走。

shots.scene: 水洼里泡着电线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cable lying in a puddle of water. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十三题：水是最好的导体？

shots.scene: 原题答案卡片旁打问号
shots.prompt_en: An answer card marked true with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原答案说对，其实金属导电更好。

shots.scene: 湿手碰开关的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand touching a switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但带杂质的水足以导电，湿手别碰电。

shots.scene: 水型灭火器对着带电配电箱，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a water extinguisher aimed at a live electrical panel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十四题：带电设备不能用水灭？

shots.scene: 先拉闸，再用二氧化碳或干粉灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the main power, then a carbon dioxide extinguisher is used. No people.
shots.narration: 对。先断电，再用合适的灭火器。

shots.scene: 火三角，抽掉一边火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: A fire triangle; one side is pulled away and the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十五题：去掉一项火就灭？

shots.scene: 欣欣竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 对。可燃物、氧气、热，缺一不可。

shots.scene: 实验楼屋顶风向袋，楼下人员往上风向走
shots.prompt_en: A windsock on the laboratory roof; people below walk upwind away from a leak.
shots.narration: 气体泄漏，看风向往上风向撤。

shots.scene: 顺风跑的人形图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person running downwind with the gas cloud, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别顺着风跑，也别往低处躲。

shots.scene: 人员在集合点清点，保卫处值班员接报
shots.prompt_en: People gather at the assembly point while the security officer takes the report.
shots.narration: 到集合点报到，报告负责人和保卫处。

shots.section_title: 实验楼禁烟与明火管理
shots.scene: 实验楼门口的禁止吸烟标志
shots.prompt_en: A no-smoking prohibition sign at the laboratory building entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 实验楼内，全面禁止吸烟。
overlay: 实验楼禁烟与明火管理

shots.section_title: 实验楼禁烟与明火管理
shots.scene: 实验室里点打火机的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of someone flicking a lighter inside a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验以外不得使用明火。

shots.section_title: 实验楼禁烟与明火管理
shots.scene: 需要明火的实验在登记表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank open-flame use log before a heating experiment.
shots.narration: 确需明火，按规定登记、有人值守。

shots.section_title: 不私自改装仪器和电路
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着拆开的仪器和缠着胶布的电线，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student with an opened instrument and a cable wrapped in tape, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 仪器坏了别自己拆，线路别私接。
overlay: 不私自改装仪器和电路

shots.section_title: 不私自改装仪器和电路
shots.scene: 排插串排插的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of power strips plugged into each other in a chain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 排插不串接，不超负荷。

shots.section_title: 不私自改装仪器和电路
shots.scene: 老李带专业工具来维修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives with proper tools to repair the instrument.
shots.narration: 报修，由专业人员处理。

shots.section_title: 大桶溶剂分装用泵和倾倒架
shots.scene: 小研抱着大桶往小瓶里倒溶剂，腰部红点，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student lifting a heavy solvent drum to pour into a small bottle, lower back glowing red, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 抱起大桶倒溶剂，容易洒也伤腰。
overlay: 大桶溶剂分装用泵和倾倒架

shots.section_title: 大桶溶剂分装用泵和倾倒架
shots.scene: 大桶放在倾倒架上，用手动泵分装
shots.prompt_en: A solvent drum sits on a tilting cradle and a hand pump transfers liquid into a small bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 用手动泵或倾倒架，省力不洒。

shots.section_title: 大桶溶剂分装用泵和倾倒架
shots.scene: 在通风柜内分装，接地夹夹在桶上
shots.prompt_en: Transfer done inside a fume hood with a grounding clip attached to the drum. No people.
shots.narration: 在通风处分装，易燃溶剂做好接地。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，对勾和叉各一列
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with a column of checks and a column of crosses.
shots.narration: 二十五道判断题，关键在为什么。

shots.scene: 梯子、安全帽、坏工具图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a two-person ladder, a drilled helmet and a welded broken tool, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不凑合、不改装、不冒险。

shots.scene: 漏电保护、接地、松手即停图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a residual current device, a ground wire and a release-to-stop trigger. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电保护、接地、松手即停。

shots.scene: 风向袋和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a windsock and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患立即报告，泄漏往上风向撤。

shots.scene: 欣欣和王老师在实验楼门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the safety administrator wave goodbye at the laboratory building entrance.
shots.narration: 判断对了，安全才对！
